correctness.rationale: For uniform labeled monomial matrices over Fq, each permutation cycle ℓ gives recurrence x_next=a*x^2, with nonzero root equation x^(2^ℓ-1)=A^-1; last weight exponent one makes A uniform in Fq*, independently across cycles. Thus a cycle contributes factor (1+dℓ Bℓ) to total idempotents M=N+1, with Bℓ~Bernoulli(1/dℓ), dℓ=gcd(q-1,2^ℓ-1). Exact symmetric-group cycle index proves all moments, the idempotent-free generating function exp(sum (1-1/dℓ)z^ℓ/ℓ), E[N]=n, and variance coefficient. dℓ>1 iff some odd prime p|q-1 has ord_p(2)|ℓ, so the exact attainable dimension support is the additive semigroup generated by these orders. For fixed q with odd part m>1, Fourier decomposition of periodic pℓ produces dominant singularities at r-th roots with exponent α and subdominant powers elsewhere, proving P_q(n)~(rC/Gamma(α))n^(α-1) along r|n and exact zeros otherwise. Independent brute-force weighted permutations and all vector idempotents over GF4 dimensions 1,2,3 matched predicted first moments and support; n=2 gave 6 of 18 structures idempotent-free, n=3 gave zero. This does not itself establish infinite asymptotics; proof uses periodic generating singularities.
